prologue.title: The Whispering Forest
prologue.narrator: When nature stops singing, the guardians know danger is approaching.
prologue.text:
Your name is {{player}}, and for several years now, you have been one of the Guardians of Nature.

Your mission seems simple: protect the extraordinary creatures that live alongside humans and prevent the balance between the two worlds from being broken.

For three generations, the Guardians have watched over this fragile pact: creatures may live near villages as long as they are neither exploited, nor caged, nor forced into anything. In return, they agree to share their world with ours.

This pact has never been unanimous. Some — mostly former Guardians — believe no compromise with humans is possible — that the only true protection would be to cut the two worlds off from each other, once and for all. They are said to have left years ago. No one has truly seen them since.

That morning, you walk among the great trees of the Golden Forest with Alya, your patrol companion.

Alya is brave, fast, and knows almost every creature in the forest.

But today, she hardly speaks at all.

The birds have fallen silent.

The little luminous foxes have vanished into their burrows.

Even the wind seems to hold its breath.

Then a rumble runs through the trees.

An immense creature bursts between the branches. Its eyes glow with blue light, and a black mark, burned into its flesh, covers its flank — a mark no Guardian has ever seen before.

Alya takes a step back.

« {{player}}... that's not a wild creature. Someone did this to it. »

In the distance, a bell rings.

The guardians' alarm signal.

choices.text: Approach the creature gently
Follow the trail of the black mark

creature.title: The Wounded Guardian
creature.narrator: Some creatures attack because they are afraid. Others because they no longer have anyone to trust.
creature.text:
You slowly raise your hands.

The creature growls but does not charge.

Alya takes a small healing stone from her pouch.

« If we heal it, it might show us what happened. »

You advance further.

The creature trembles.

Then you notice a small metal chain around its paw.

It bears the symbol of an unknown organization: a black circle surrounding a white claw.

Suddenly, the creature places its paw on the ground.

A vision appears.

Cages.

Captured creatures.

Figures dressed in black cloaks.

And an immense stone door opening beneath a mountain.

Alya turns pale.

« I know this symbol... »

She clenches her fists.

« They call themselves the Liberators. They believe creatures should never depend on humans again — not even to be healed, not even to be protected. »

She points to the black mark on the creature's flank.

« This mark isn't a wound. It's a rite they force on every creature they capture, to sever the bond of trust it has with us. Once marked, it can no longer tell a human who wants to help from a human who wants to cage it. »

The creature trembles harder, as if confirming her words.

« Their leader is called Corvin. He once swore the same oath as I did, before giving it all up. »

choices.text: Ask Alya what she knows
Follow the vision to the mountain

piste.title: Marks in the Mud
piste.narrator: A trail can lead to danger. But it can also reveal the truth.
piste.text:
You crouch near the tracks left in the mud.

They don't look like an animal's.

Boots.

Many boots.

Beside them, several creature prints seem to have been dragged by force.

Alya examines a broken branch.

« They passed here last night. »

You advance with her to an old abandoned cabin.

Inside, you find regional maps, ropes, empty cages, and several posters depicting fantastic creatures.

On one of them, someone wrote:

« Humans will never change. »

Alya stays silent before the sentence.

On a map pinned to the wall, several villages are circled with the same symbol: a black circle around a white claw.

« The Liberators, » Alya whispers. « They mark every creature they capture, by force, to sever the bond of trust it has toward us. Once marked, it can't tell a friend from a jailer. »

She stares at the symbol for a long moment.

« Their leader is called Corvin. He swore the same oath as I did, before giving it all up. »

Then you find a map indicating a mountain to the north.

The same black symbol is drawn on it.

choices.text: Take the map and alert the Guardians
Head immediately toward the mountain

alya_secret.title: Alya's Secret
alya_secret.location: GOLDEN FOREST — BENEATH THE GREAT OAKS
alya_secret.narrator: Sometimes, those who accompany us carry their own wounds.
alya_secret.text:
Alya looks away.

« I've heard of them before. »

She hesitates.

« When I was little, a creature I was protecting was hurt by humans. After that, it was afraid of everyone. I never managed to earn its trust again. »

She lowers her head.

« The Liberators say no creature should depend on humans. They want to open all the reserves, free all the creatures, and make the cities that surround them disappear. »

You ask her if she thinks they're right.

Alya doesn't answer right away.

« I don't know anymore. »

A noise rings out behind you.

Branches crack.

Someone is watching you.

choices.text: Stay and search for who is watching
Leave discreetly toward the mountain

refuge.title: The Guardians' Refuge
refuge.narrator: When a threat grows, guardians must choose between acting quickly and understanding first.
refuge.text:
The refuge is hidden behind a waterfall.

You present the map to the council of Guardians.

The room falls silent.

Master Elian, the eldest of the guardians, studies the black symbol.

« The Liberators have returned. »

He explains that they have long sought an ancient sanctuary capable of controlling the most powerful creatures in the world.

If the sanctuary is activated, the creatures could lose their free will.

« You must reach the mountain before them. »

Alya steps forward.

« And if we fail? »

Elian answers softly:

« Then you will have to remind humans and creatures why they chose to live together. »

An old winged creature waits before the refuge.

It seems ready to lead you.

choices.text: Leave with the winged creature
Ask for an old map of the sanctuary

archives.title: The Forbidden Map
archives.narrator: Old maps don't just show paths. Sometimes they show the mistakes of the past.
archives.text:
The archives are filled with dusty books and maps so old their colors have nearly vanished.

You finally find a map hidden behind a shelf.

It depicts the northern mountain.

But something is strange.

The sanctuary is not beneath the mountain.

It is beneath the lake behind it.

Alya reads an inscription on the back of the map:

« Only those who refuse to choose between the two worlds can open the door. »

Alya frowns.

« I think that sentence is about us. »

A tremor suddenly shakes the refuge.

Outside, an immense red light appears in the sky.

The Liberators have just begun their attack.

choices.text: Run to defend the refuge
Use the chaos to leave for the lake

embuscade.title: The Liberators
embuscade.narrator: You are never alone when an organization is looking for you.
embuscade.text:
Three figures appear between the trees.

They wear the symbol of the white claw.

The person at the center removes their hood.

Alya stiffens.

« Corvin. »

« {{player}}. »

He knows your name.

« We don't want to fight you. We only want to stop humans from continuing to use creatures. »

Alya takes a step forward.

« You mark them by force for that. Don't you see the problem? »

Corvin doesn't look away.

« I wore the same uniform as you, Alya. I believed the same promises. Then I saw what was left of them. »

« We have stopped believing that harmony was possible. »

He places a small shining stone on the ground.

« Come see the sanctuary. You will understand. »

Then the three figures disappear into the forest.

choices.text: Ignore their invitation and continue toward the mountain
Take the mysterious stone

pierre.title: The Stone That Listens
pierre.narrator: Some stones guard secrets. This one seems to guard memories above all.
pierre.text:
The moment you touch the stone, you hear voices.

Dozens of voices.

Humans.

Wolves.

Birds.

Creatures whose names you don't even know.

All speaking at once.

Then one voice becomes clearer.

« Harmony doesn't mean everyone is the same. It means everyone can choose. »

Alya listens too.

Her face changes.

« That's exactly what my mother used to say. »

She takes the stone.

But a shadow appears on the surface of the water.

A gigantic aquatic creature watches you.

It points its snout toward the north.

choices.text: Follow the creature to the lake
Ask the creature to lead you to the mountain

voyage.title: Above the Clouds
voyage.narrator: From above, the borders between worlds seem very small.
voyage.text:
The winged creature carries you above the forest.

The villages become tiny.

The rivers look like threads of silver.

And farther away, the mountain appears.

A column of black light rises from its summit.

Alya grits her teeth.

« They've already begun. »

Suddenly, a swarm of small flying creatures surrounds you.

They don't seem hostile.

They show you a path to a lake hidden behind the mountain.

One of them lands on your shoulder.

It chirps as if it wants to tell you something.

You understand that it wants you to follow it.

choices.text: Follow the small creatures
Go directly to the summit

montagne.title: The Black Mountain
montagne.narrator: Some mountains hide treasures. This one hides a decision.
montagne.text:
The path becomes narrower and narrower.

Snow covers the stones.

As you climb, you spot abandoned cages and traces of magic on the rocks.

Alya stops before a gigantic door.

It is covered with symbols depicting humans and creatures living side by side.

At the center, a phrase is engraved:

« No world must possess the other. »

The door opens slowly.

Behind it lies an immense staircase descending into the mountain.

Alya looks at you.

« {{player}}... whatever is down there, we must stay together. »

choices.text: Descend into the sanctuary
Search first for the lake indicated on the map

lac.title: The Lake of Reflections
lac.narrator: A reflection doesn't always show what exists. Sometimes it shows what we fear.
lac.text:
The lake is perfectly still.

No waves.

No insects.

Even your reflections seem strange.

When you look at the water, you see the village where you grew up.

But it is empty.

Alya looks too.

She sees a forest without humans.

Free creatures roam the deserted streets.

She murmurs:

« That's what they want to create. »

Then the lake lights up.

A door appears beneath the surface.

A voice echoes:

« Those who choose only one world will doom both. »

Alya looks at you.

« {{player}}... we need to find a third path. »

choices.text: Dive toward the door
Return to the mountain

attaque_refuge.title: Defending the Refuge
attaque_refuge.narrator: Protecting creatures sometimes means protecting those who protect them.
attaque_refuge.text:
The refuge trembles under bursts of magic.

Creatures hide in the underground halls.

The Guardians try to repel the invaders without hurting anyone.

You spot a small creature trapped beneath a beam.

Farther away, a group of Liberators approaches.

Alya runs toward you.

« {{player}}! We have to choose! »

You look at the wounded creature.

Then the attackers.

The fight could wait.

She couldn't.

choices.text: Save the creature
Repel the Liberators

sauvetage.title: The Little Dragon
sauvetage.narrator: Courage isn't always about defeating an enemy. Sometimes it's about stopping to help.
sauvetage.text:
You lift the beam with Alya.

The small creature emerges trembling.

It's a young dragon with wings too large for its body.

It sneezes.

A small flame shoots from its nose and sets the nearby curtain on fire.

Alya laughs despite the danger.

« I think it just thanked us. »

The dragon looks at you, then flies down the corridor.

It returns a few seconds later with a piece of black cloth in its mouth.

The Liberators' symbol is embroidered on it.

But beneath the symbol, an address is written.

The mountain.

The sanctuary.

choices.text: Follow the dragon to the mountain
Help the Guardians evacuate the refuge first

evacuation_refuge.title: Exit Through the Shadows
evacuation_refuge.narrator: Protecting the weakest sometimes takes longer than facing the enemy — but rarely takes less courage.
evacuation_refuge.text:
You guide frightened creatures through the emergency tunnel while Alya covers the rear.

The young dragon keeps coming back, as if making sure no one is left behind.

Master Elian brings up the rear, his staff lighting the damp walls.

« They targeted the sanctuary, » he murmurs. « Not us. We still have a chance if they don't reach the lake before us. »

At the end of the tunnel, the forest opens beneath a fine rain.

The mountain shines in the distance, surrounded by a dark halo.

choices.text: Cut through the forest to save time
Ask Elian if he knows a passage to the lake

combat_refuge.title: The Guardians' Battle
combat_refuge.narrator: A battle can be won without anyone being forced to become a monster.
combat_refuge.text:
You run toward the invaders.

The Guardians form a barrier before the creatures.

The Liberators use black magic that shakes the ground.

You manage to disable their main device.

The attackers retreat.

But before fleeing, their leader shouts:

« You understand nothing! The sanctuary will open soon! »

Alya joins you.

« We have to go. Now. »

Behind you, the refuge still stands.

Before you, the mountain is lit by a gigantic column of light.

choices.text: Leave immediately for the sanctuary
Check first that the creature beneath the beam is safe

porte_lac.title: Beneath the Lake
porte_lac.narrator: The most impossible paths sometimes hide the simplest answers.
porte_lac.text:
You dive.

But instead of running out of air, you discover the water becomes luminous around you.

Alya swims at your side.

You cross the door.

Behind it lies an immense underground hall.

Statues of creatures surround a stone circle.

At the center stands a crystal.

When you approach, a voice echoes:

« The sanctuary's power doesn't control creatures. It amplifies their will. »

Alya understands immediately.

« If the Liberators activate this with their anger, all the creatures could turn against humans. »

A door opens in the rock.

Footsteps echo behind.

choices.text: Hide the crystal
Wait for the Liberators

sommet.title: The Burning Summit
sommet.narrator: When two visions of the world clash, someone must have the courage to propose something else.
sommet.text:
At the summit, an immense stone structure dominates the mountain.

Dozens of Liberators surround a luminous circle.

At the center stands Corvin.

And beside him, you recognize several captured creatures — each bears the same black mark as the one you met in the forest.

Alya freezes.

« No... »

Corvin raises his hand.

« Look at them! Humans imprisoned them. We will finally free them! »

Alya steps forward.

« Freeing them doesn't mean asking them to destroy the world. »

Corvin replies:

« You say that because you're still afraid of what might happen. »

Alya doesn't answer.

She leans toward you.

« The crystal, at the center of the circle... it doesn't obey orders. It amplifies what the creatures feel. If Corvin activates it now, with their fear and their anger, they won't just leave. They'll turn against us. »

Then you understand something.

The real battle may not be against the Liberators.

It will be against the fear that drove them this far — and against the time left before Corvin activates the crystal.

choices.text: Speak to the leader
🔒 Free the captured creatures (Courage ≥ 30)

sanctuaire.title: Heart of the Sanctuary
sanctuaire.narrator: The greatest power is not the one that commands. It's the one that lets choose.
sanctuaire.text:
The staircase opens into a gigantic hall.

Hundreds of crystals float in the air.

Each seems to contain a creature's memory.

You advance.

A light appears before you.

It takes the form of an ancient guardian.

« For centuries, humans and creatures have protected one another. But each generation must choose again to live together. »

Alya lowers her eyes.

« And if we get it wrong? »

The guardian answers:

« Then you will learn. Harmony is not a promise never to make mistakes. »

Suddenly, the sanctuary trembles.

The Liberators have arrived.

choices.text: Protect the sanctuary
Search for another exit

cristal.title: The Crystal of Choice
cristal.narrator: A dangerous power becomes even more dangerous when you believe you're the only one who knows how to use it.
cristal.text:
You take the crystal.

Immediately, all the creatures in the sanctuary appear around you.

You feel their fear.

Their anger.

But also their happy memories with humans.

Alya gently places her hand on your shoulder.

« We must not choose for them. »

Then you understand how to use the crystal.

It must belong neither to the Guardians nor to the Liberators.

It must be returned to the creatures themselves.

But a voice rings out behind you.

« Put down that crystal. »

Alya turns around.

It's the leader of the Liberators.

And he holds a black key capable of activating the sanctuary.

choices.text: 🔒 Try to convince the leader (Courage ≥ 30)
Give the crystal to the creatures

liberation.title: Open Doors
liberation.narrator: To free someone is also to accept not knowing what they will do next.
liberation.text:
You open the cages.

One by one, the creatures emerge.

Some flee.

Others remain motionless.

A large silver wolf approaches Corvin.

He looks at him for a long time.

Then he turns and walks into the forest.

Corvin is speechless.

Alya murmurs:

« They can choose. »

A small creature comes to stand beside you.

Then a second.

Then a third.

But freeing the creatures didn't deactivate the crystal.

At the center of the circle, it begins to vibrate, as if still searching for a will to amplify — and Corvin hasn't left his post.

« The crystal won't stop on its own, » Alya whispers. « Someone has to decide what we do with it. »

choices.text: Let the creatures decide
Destroy the crystal

confrontation.title: The Final Discussion
confrontation.narrator: It sometimes takes more courage to listen to an adversary than to fight them.
confrontation.text:
The leader of the Liberators advances.

« Why do you still defend humans? »

You answer:

« Because some humans harm creatures. But some protect them too. »

Alya takes a deep breath.

« And some creatures frighten humans. Yet we don't decide they're all bad. »

Silence falls.

The leader looks at the crystal.

For a few seconds, you think he will lower his weapon.

But he grips the black key.

« Then prove to me that harmony is possible. »

He activates the sanctuary.

choices.text: Trust the creatures
Use the power of the sanctuary

choix_final.title: The Creatures' Choice
choix_final.narrator: To live together, we must sometimes accept that the other chooses something we wouldn't have chosen ourselves.
choix_final.text:
The crystal rises into the air.

A light crosses the sanctuary.

All the creatures present can finally choose.

Some return to the forests.

Others stay near the villages.

A few approach humans.

No one commands them.

No one gives them orders.

Alya looks at the leader of the Liberators.

He falls to his knees.

« They... really choose. »

You nod.

« That's harmony. »

The sun rises above the mountain.

For the first time in a long while, humans and creatures look at the same horizon.

pouvoir.title: Absolute Power
pouvoir.narrator: Power can solve a problem. But it can't teach beings to understand one another.
pouvoir.text:
You use the power of the sanctuary.

A wave of light crosses the mountain.

All the creatures stop.

Silence is total.

For a moment, you could give them any order.

Alya looks at you with worry.

« {{player}}... you really can control them all. »

Then you understand the trap.

Even if your intention is good, controlling them would be doing exactly what the Liberators blame humans for.

You release the power.

The crystal cracks.

The light disappears.

The creatures regain their freedom.

The sanctuary begins to collapse.

choices.text: Save Alya and get out
Go back for the leader of the Liberators

destruction.title: The End of the Crystal
destruction.narrator: Destroying a power can be harder than using it.
destruction.text:
You raise the crystal.

Alya understands what you're going to do.

« {{player}}... if you destroy it, no one will ever be able to use this power again. »

You strike.

The crystal explodes in a white light.

All the magical chains disappear.

The creatures are free.

The sanctuary begins to collapse.

Amid the falling stones, the leader of the Liberators remains motionless.

He watches the creatures leave without receiving any order.

« Perhaps... we had forgotten why we wanted to free them. »

Alya smiles.

« Then it's time to start again differently. »

choices.text: Leave the mountain with the leader of the Liberators
Let the leader think alone and join the Guardians

fin_reconciliation.title: A New Alliance
fin_reconciliation.narrator: Great stories don't always end with victory. Some begin with a second chance.
fin_reconciliation.text:
A few days later, the Guardians' refuge welcomes an unexpected visitor.

The leader of the Liberators came without a weapon.

He doesn't ask forgiveness right away.

He simply tells what he lived through.

The Guardians listen.

Alya too.

Then a creature approaches him.

The same silver wolf he had freed.

The wolf sits before him.

The leader extends his hand.

The wolf doesn't back away.

For the first time, both sides work together.

Not to control creatures.

Not to separate them from humans.

But to let them choose.

Alya looks at {{player}}.

« Do you think we succeeded? »

In the distance, a small creature sneezes and accidentally sets the refuge's sign on fire.

{{player}} smiles.

« Looks like the work is just beginning. »

fin_gardiens.title: Guardian of Harmony
fin_gardiens.narrator: You don't become a guardian because you're strong enough to command. You become one because you know when to let others choose.
fin_gardiens.text:
You leave the mountain with Alya as the sun rises.

Behind you, the sanctuary has collapsed.

Its power can never again be used to control creatures.

The Guardians arrive shortly after.

Master Elian listens to your story without interrupting.

Then he smiles.

« You understood something many guardians take a lifetime to learn. »

Alya looks at the forest.

Creatures appear between the trees.

They don't flee from you.

They watch you.

Then the young dragon from the refuge lands on Alya's shoulder.

It sneezes.

A small flame shoots from its nose.

Alya bursts out laughing.

The forest begins to sing again.

And you, {{player}}, understand that your adventure is only beginning.

route_montagne.title: The Mountain Path
route_montagne.narrator: Refusing an invitation is sometimes choosing a harder path — but a more honest one.
route_montagne.text:
You turn away from the shining stone.

« We keep going, » you tell Alya.

She nods, almost relieved.

The trail climbs silently between the rocks.

The wind grows colder with each step.

In the distance, the mountain rises, dark despite the evening light.

Alya pulls her hood tighter.

« I don't like this silence. »

You don't either.

Even the forest's most discreet creatures have vanished.

Only the sound of your footsteps echoes on the stone.

Then, around the bend, the mountain appears in full before you.

choices.text: Climb the main trail
Take the slippery shortcut along the cliffs

passage_falaise.title: The Eagles' Passage
passage_falaise.narrator: Shortcuts offered by nature are never free. They only demand a different kind of price.
passage_falaise.text:
The path narrows to a wind-battered ledge.

Giant eagles circle above you, their cries mixed with the distant rumble of black magic.

Alya grips your hand.

« If we fall, no one will reach the sanctuary. »

One of the birds suddenly descends and places a silver feather at your feet, like an offering.

You understand: they want to guide you, not frighten you.

The ledge leads directly to a forgotten stone door, engraved with the same symbols as the mountain door.

choices.text: Enter through the secret door
Go back down and join the main trail

sillage_lac.title: In the Creature's Wake
sillage_lac.location: STREAM — ON THE WAY TO THE LAKE
sillage_lac.narrator: Some creatures don't speak, but they always know where the true path leads.
sillage_lac.text:
The aquatic creature glides before you between the stream's rocks.

It never turns back, as if it knows you're following.

Alya still clutches the stone against her.

« Those voices... they haven't fallen silent yet, » she murmurs.

The stream gradually widens.

The trees part.

A scent of calm water rises in the evening air.

The creature suddenly stops and dives.

Before you stretches an immense, perfectly still surface.

« We're here, » Alya whispers.

choices.text: Touch the water to see if the vision returns
Ask Alya what the stone is still whispering to her

reflet_lac.title: Reflections That Speak
reflet_lac.narrator: Seeing your own fear reflected in the water isn't punishment. It's sometimes the first step to overcoming it.
reflet_lac.text:
You dip your fingers into the icy water.

The reflections blur, then reform.

You see children playing with creatures in your village.

Alya sees her mother tending a wounded wolf.

« They don't want to destroy our memories, » she murmurs. « They want to convince us these images never existed. »

The lake's surface lights up.

Beneath the water, the stone door becomes visible, as if it had been waiting forever.

choices.text: Dive toward the door
Circle the lake to reach the mountain

approche_sommet.title: Toward the Summit
approche_sommet.location: SKY OF THE MOUNTAINS — FINAL APPROACH
approche_sommet.narrator: The closer you get to danger, the louder the silence becomes.
approche_sommet.text:
The winged creature banks its wings and dives toward the summit.

Wind whistles in your ears.

The column of black light grows every second.

Alya leans toward you.

« Whatever we find up there, we stay together. »

You squeeze her hand for a moment.

The clouds finally part.

The stone structure on the summit appears, immense, surrounded by hooded figures.

The creature slows its flight and begins its descent.

choices.text: Land in the middle of the Liberators' circle
Land behind the rocks to observe first

observation_sommet.title: Behind the Rocks
observation_sommet.narrator: Observing before acting doesn't always slow the story. Sometimes it's what allows you to change it.
observation_sommet.text:
The winged creature lands quietly behind a pile of stones.

From there, you can see the cages, Corvin, and the crystal pulsing at the center of the circle.

Alya counts the attackers in a low voice.

« Too many for a frontal fight. But look: the sanctuary door is still open. »

She points to the crystal.

« That crystal obeys no one, {{player}}. It amplifies what the creatures feel. As long as they bear Corvin's mark, we'd better get them out of there before he activates it — their fear alone would be enough to make everything collapse. »

A young dragon — the same one from the refuge — circles above the cages, as if looking for a gap.

You have time to choose how to intervene.

choices.text: 🔒 Free the captured creatures in silence (Courage ≥ 25)
Descend and confront the leader directly

reflexion_cristal.title: Breath Before the Choice
reflexion_cristal.narrator: Returning a power is sometimes more courageous than keeping it.
reflexion_cristal.text:
The leader of the Liberators grips the black key, ready to act.

But you don't back down.

Alya stands at your side, hands trembling but firm.

« Are you sure? » she asks softly.

You look at the crystal, then at the creatures around you, silent, attentive.

« This choice doesn't belong to us, » you answer.

The leader takes a step forward to stop you.

But it's already too late.

You raise the crystal toward the gathered creatures.

choices.text: Speak to the leader one last time before returning the crystal
Hand the crystal to the creatures without waiting
